# Enhanced Code Analysis Plugin

**NOT IMPLEMENTED** — tool registration was withdrawn during the 2026-09-14 audit.

The previous handlers returned `Math.random()`-generated complexity scores, pass/fail
verdicts, vulnerability severities and line numbers, plus a hardcoded dependency graph.
Plausible-looking random results are more dangerous than empty ones: an empty result gets
noticed, a plausible random one does not.

See `docs/operations-log.md` (2026-09-14) for the audit record and the restoration path.
